definition: A technology that encrypts DNS queries to prevent eavesdropping and manipulation of internet traffic routing, protecting users from DNS-based attacks and surveillance.
metaDescription: Learn about Secure DNS - encrypted DNS queries that protect your internet browsing from surveillance, manipulation, and DNS-based attacks.
simpleExplanation: When you visit a website, your device asks a DNS server for the site's address. Secure DNS encrypts these requests so others can't see what websites you're trying to visit or redirect you to malicious sites.
whyItMatters: Without Secure DNS, anyone monitoring your network can see every website you visit, even with HTTPS. It also prevents attackers from redirecting you to fake websites or blocking access to legitimate ones.
technicalDetail: Secure DNS protocols like DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and DNS over TLS (DoT) encrypt DNS queries using standard encryption methods. This prevents DNS spoofing, cache poisoning attacks, and protects against ISP monitoring of browsing habits while maintaining the same functionality as traditional DNS.

examples.explanation: When configured to use Cloudflare's secure DNS, your DNS queries are encrypted, preventing your ISP from logging which websites you visit for advertising or other purposes.
On unsecured public Wi-Fi, attackers might redirect banking websites to fake copies. Secure DNS prevents this by ensuring DNS responses haven't been tampered with.
In regions where ISPs block certain websites through DNS filtering, secure DNS can help bypass these restrictions by using uncensored DNS servers.
